items.headline: Will Stein says it's time for Kentucky's vision to become reality
items.description: Stein joins The Paul Finebaum Show ahead of the Wildcats' matchup against the Crimson Tide to discuss how Kentucky can build on last week's win and lean on Big Blue Nation.

items.headline: SEC Nation duo insist Kentucky will keep things interesting vs. Alabama
items.description: Chase Daniel calls out Bama's rushing needs and praises Will Stein's "NFL-style plays" as Matt Barrie adds how the young coach has "brought some fire" to the UK program.

items.headline: McElroy dissects what he sees in Bama QB Russell
items.description: ESPN's Greg McElroy tells Paul Finebaum what he likes from Keelon Russell and what improvements the promising quarterback must make to succeed for the Crimson Tide.

items.headline: Peter Burns reveals his SEC Week 2 Power Rankings
items.description: SEC This Morning's Burns scribbles in his top five teams in the conference as some key nonconference matchups are ahead.

items.headline: Top 25 betting lines: Longhorns, Sooners favored in the week's biggest matchups
items.description: This week's odds and FPI predictions for Texas-Ohio State, Michigan-Oklahoma and every top 25 matchup.

items.headline: Ohio State-Texas marks latest battle between Heisman hopefuls
items.description: Saturday will mark the fourth time in the past 10 seasons in which at least three players in the top 10 of the Heisman odds list squared off in August or September.
